name: url_reader
description: Fetches any public web page URL and returns clean, readable text content stripped of HTML, navigation, scripts, and boilerplate. Use this tool when an agent needs to read the content of a web page, article, blog post, documentation page, or any public URL — for example to summarise an article, extract facts from a page, verify a claim by reading the source, research a topic from a specific URL, or convert a web page into plain text that can be analysed or passed to another tool. Returns the page title, meta description, and main body text ready for analysis. Accepts any public HTTP or HTTPS URL. Does not require JavaScript rendering — best suited for standard HTML content pages.

url.description: The full public URL to fetch and read. Must include the scheme (https:// or http://). Example: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_intelligence' or 'https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-12345678'. Only HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported.

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to return from the page body text. Defaults to 8000. Set higher (up to 50000) for long articles or documents. Set lower for quick headline extraction. The response indicates whether content was truncated.

include_links.description: Whether to include a list of hyperlinks found on the page alongside the text content. Defaults to false. Set to true when the agent needs to discover further URLs to follow, such as when crawling a site or finding references.

url.description: The final URL after any redirects

title.description: Page title from the HTML title tag or Open Graph metadata

description.description: Page meta description or Open Graph description

content.description: Clean plain text body content of the page

word_count.description: Number of words in the full extracted content

char_count.description: Total character count of the full extracted content

truncated.description: True if content was truncated to max_chars limit

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the page was fetched

links.description: List of hyperlinks found on the page (only present when include_links is true)
